sections.heading: 0.1.0-alpha.49
paragraphs: Previously sent Miggi screen captures can now be found and opened again as original images, with small composer and Warm Linen fixes.
Update from the exact public alpha.48 using Check → Download → Update and restart. Memory stays V039; no new migration is required.
Personal test alpha: real GUI retrieval and restart checks passed; Roman will check the installed alpha.48 → alpha.49 update on his PC.

sections.heading: Checks that the bytes match. It does not replace a publisher’s digital signature.
Alpha
paragraphs: Updates are checked automatically; download and installation require confirmation.

sections.heading: Added
paragraphs: Historical capture lookup by original message/conversation, first or latest captures, and pagination. The AI can request the verified original pixels without taking a new screenshot.

sections.heading: Fixed
paragraphs: Attachment removal hover now darkens the thumbnail transparently instead of covering it with a solid fill.
Custom tooltips explicitly use the active theme colours and an opaque readable surface; ordinary empty tooltips no longer create a blank panel.
Composer actions share sizes and spacing in text and voice modes. Stop and Send keep their slots; Cancel stays at the left start of the input regardless of avatar side.

sections.heading: Known limitations
paragraphs: No Windows Authenticode signature. Do not bypass SmartScreen/SAC or disable protection. Update-channel signing is not a Windows publisher signature.
Sent screen captures retain their existing 30-day lifetime. Missing, changed or expired originals cannot be recovered from a thumbnail; lookup is not semantic image-content search.
After restart the AI may perform extra searches before finding the capture. This remains an efficiency improvement, not a claim that every retrieval path is optimal.
Fresh installation and the exact installed alpha.48 → alpha.49 path await manual acceptance. Other recorded TODOs, including the reported theme reset after update, are not declared fixed.
